value.name: gather paper and leave
value.description: She collects the single sheet of paper, puts it back in her bag, and prepares to depart.
evidence: She gathered the single sheet of paper. She put it back in her bag.

value.name: put on coat unaided
value.description: In the hall, she puts on her coat without Lucia's help, signaling a small shift in independence.
evidence: She put on her coat in the hall this time without Lucia's help

value.name: say goodbye at front door
value.description: She says her goodbyes at the front door and leaves the dining room behind without reentering it.
evidence: she said her goodbyes at the front door without crossing the threshold of the dining room again

value.name: step into changed afternoon
value.description: She goes down the stoop into a Thursday afternoon that has turned into thin, surprising sunlight while she was inside.
evidence: she went down the stoop into a Thursday afternoon that had turned, while she was inside, into a thin and surprising sunlight

value.name: pause at bottom of steps
value.description: She pauses at the bottom of the steps with her hand on the iron railing, lingering before moving on.
evidence: she stood for a moment at the bottom of the steps with her hand on the iron railing

value.name: realize uncertainty about house
value.description: She realizes she does not yet know what will happen in the house between now and Monday week.
evidence: She did not yet know, she realized, what would happen in that house between now and Monday week.

value.name: wonder about Daniel's change
value.description: She considers whether Daniel will keep or lose the version of himself he revealed at the table.
evidence: She did not know whether Daniel would, in the privacy of the days ahead, find the version of himself he had glimpsed at the table or lose it again.

value.name: wonder about Lucia's response
value.description: She considers whether Lucia will accept Rosa's offer or reject it repeatedly until it becomes a wound between them.
evidence: She did not know whether Lucia would accept Rosa's offer or refuse it on principle and then refuse it again on a different principle until the offer became a wound between them.

value.name: reflect on speaking openly
value.description: She wonders whether saying the largest thing she has said in thirty-one years has opened a door she can no longer easily close.
evidence: She did not know whether Rosa, having said the largest thing she had said in thirty-one years, would be able to say anything else for a while, or whether the saying of it had opened in her a door she had kept closed for very good reasons and could not now easily close again.

value.name: learn codicil filed and buyers gone
value.description: She knows the codicil has been filed and the buyers have left, confirming the immediate transaction is complete.
evidence: She knew only that the codicil had been filed, and that the buyers were gone

value.name: anticipate appraisal and future meeting
value.description: She knows the appraisal will arrive on Wednesday and that on Monday week the three of them will meet again to decide their future.
